capabilities: Extract matching lines, delimited content, headings, callouts, and file metadata into frontmatter properties
Trigger rules on note modify, open, focus, or manual command
Post-process extracted values with filters, regex extraction, and template formatting
Import and export rule sets as JSON
extras: Full documentation and examples live in a separate wiki. Rules created in V1.0 are erased by the V2.0 update and must be re-created once. Can also be installed via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian properties must be filled in by hand, and there is no built-in way to derive their values from note content automatically.

relations.evidence: Pairs well with Bases, Templates, and Dataview.

summary: Rule-based plugin that automatically fills note frontmatter properties by extracting content like tasks, highlights, headings, and file metadata.
